sources.prompt: Edit the attached REAL photographic reference of Renfe Civia 465 into a clean documentary photograph of its CURRENT, unrefurbished passenger cabin for a railway game. This is a restrained photographic retouch, NOT a redesigned train. Preserve this exact camera position, perspective, window locations, grey moulded seat shells, separate grey headrests, mauve-grey fabric seat inserts, metal seat supports, continuous open gangway, straight stainless handrails with red joints, white curved wall panels, baggage racks, ceiling lights, real 2+2 seating geometry and long clear aisle. Remove all people and their belongings, carefully reconstruct only the small areas they occluded. Neutralize posters and displays into plain unobtrusive panels, no gibberish text. Retain the everyday original upholstery and flooring, realistic soft wear but no damage. Do not add handles, armrests, partitions, rows or seats that are not in the real photo. Crisp realistic natural daylight, physically straight parallel rails and panel joints, no warped or fused chair legs. Output ONE photograph, landscape 3:2, 1536 by 1024, no collage, labels, border, watermarks or decorative graphics.

Edit this exact attached Civia 465 cabin photograph to show a plausible finished INTERIOR REFURBISHMENT. Pixel-aligned before/after photograph: keep the camera, crop, perspective, sunlight and shadows, all seat shapes, seat count, seat orientations, window frames, white wall shells, floor footprint, gangway and every stainless handrail in exactly the same location. Make only surface-material updates: replace each mauve-grey fabric cushion insert with fresh uniform deep burgundy woven upholstery, retain grey plastic seat shells and their separate grey headrests, renew the grey slip-resistant floor with a clean even finer texture, replace the existing ceiling light fixtures' lighting with neutral white LED without changing their housings, clean the white panels and steel. Existing blank screens remain simple dark screens. The broad foreground vestibule must stay empty and accessible. Do not redesign seats, add or remove armrests, windows, poles, seats, panels or partitions. No people, no textual graphics, no luxury rendering. Retain precise real-world joints and supports. ONE 1536x1024 landscape 3:2 documentary photograph, no collage, borders or labels.

Use this attached REAL photograph of a Spanish-built Renfe-series 592 regional diesel train cabin (this example operates for CP in Portugal) as the visual reference for the game's S592 Camello interior. Faithful restrained photographic retouch. Preserve these original reversible tall upholstered 2+2 seats, the raised passenger saloon behind the low vestibule partitions, central stainless steel pole, window positions, straight tubular baggage racks and old cream ceiling with paired fluorescent fixtures and round vents. Preserve exact camera perspective and the visible 2+2 layout. Remove the few passengers and white headrest cloths including the CP logos, carefully exposing matching original dark blue fabric underneath. Keep existing blue seats and sober slightly aged grey floor, do not add new furniture. Neutralize tiny notices into plain plates without fake writing. Crop/reframe minimally into a ONE 3:2 landscape documentary photograph, 1536x1024, extending only the plain vestibule floor if necessary. Real photographic materials, daylight, no symmetry hallucination, no distorted/fused seats, poles or windows, no collage, labels, borders or watermarks.

Edit the attached S592 Camello regional cabin photograph to show a realistic renovation of the SAME cabin. Exact before/after alignment: identical 1536x1024 camera framing, all window edges, partitions, central pole, floor junctions, reversible seat shapes, arms and row positions unchanged. Change only visible surface finishes: replace blue seat upholstery with fresh muted burgundy durable woven fabric, renew grey non-slip flooring, clean the cream wall panels, illuminate existing fluorescent fixture housings with neutral LED tubes. Retain the characteristic old Camello ceiling vents, luggage racks and open low partitions. Leave the pole, rack rods, fittings and seat frames in their exact positions. This is a modest sensible refurbishment, not a redesigned or luxury interior. Keep exterior landscape and daylight identical. No new monitors, objects, people, text, collage or labels.
